Italian

Verb

chiamàrsi (first-person singular present mi chiàmo, first-person singular past historic mi chiamài, past participle chiamàtosi)

  1. reflexive of chiamare
  2. to be called or named
    Come ti chiami?
    What's your name?
    Mi chiamo Fred.
    My name is Fred.
